from solution import check_distinct
import inspect


def test_issue_example_with_repeats():
    """Issue example says (1, 4, 5, 6, 1, 4) is not distinct."""
    # set {1,4,5,6} size 4 < len 6, so False
    assert check_distinct((1, 4, 5, 6, 1, 4)) == False


def test_issue_empty_tuple_is_distinct():
    """Empty tuple has no repeats so it is distinct."""
    # set size 0 == len 0, so True
    assert check_distinct(()) == True


def test_issue_single_element_is_distinct():
    """A single-element tuple has no repeats so it is distinct."""
    # set size 1 == len 1, so True
    assert check_distinct((42,)) == True


def test_issue_all_distinct_ints():
    """Tuple with all different ints is distinct."""
    # set size 5 == len 5, so True
    assert check_distinct((1, 2, 3, 4, 5)) == True


def test_issue_all_same_is_not_distinct():
    """Tuple with all equal elements is not distinct."""
    # set {2} size 1 < len 4, so False
    assert check_distinct((2, 2, 2, 2)) == False


def test_issue_adjacent_duplicate():
    """Tuple with an adjacent duplicate is not distinct."""
    # set {1,2,3} size 3 < len 4, so False
    assert check_distinct((1, 2, 2, 3)) == False


def test_issue_first_last_duplicate():
    """Tuple with duplicate first and last elements is not distinct."""
    # set {9,1,2,3} size 4 < len 5, so False
    assert check_distinct((9, 1, 2, 3, 9)) == False


def test_issue_distinct_strings():
    """Tuple with all different strings is distinct."""
    # set size 3 == len 3, so True
    assert check_distinct(("a", "b", "c")) == True


def test_issue_duplicate_strings():
    """Tuple with a repeated string is not distinct."""
    # set {x,y} size 2 < len 3, so False
    assert check_distinct(("x", "y", "x")) == False


def test_contract_input_tuple_unchanged():
    """Function must not modify the given tuple."""
    # len 3 stays 3, value (1, 2, 1) unchanged
    tup = (1, 2, 1)
    check_distinct(tup)
    assert tup == (1, 2, 1)


def test_contract_takes_single_argument():
    """Public interface shows check_distinct(test_tup) takes one argument."""
    # 1 parameter listed in def check_distinct(test_tup), so 1
    assert len(inspect.signature(check_distinct).parameters) == 1


def test_contract_repeatable_result():
    """Repeated calls on the same tuple give the same distinct answer."""
    # set {1,2} size 2 < len 3, so False on both calls
    assert check_distinct((1, 2, 1)) == check_distinct((1, 2, 1)) == False
